wager.offer: One hundred dollars. It was never yours, so you cannot truly lose it. Grow it by a tenth and I grant you one wish. Lose a tenth and I take it back, and you keep nothing but what you learned. Which, I suspect, you will undervalue.

endings.title: The Hollow Wish
endings.speaker: vela
lines: You cleared my line. A wish, then, as promised.
Though I notice you got there by putting everything on one number and holding your breath.
endings.next: You got lucky. Luck is not a method, and it does not come twice. Spend the wish carefully.
endings.coach_coda: She's not wrong, and she's not being kind about it. You won this one. Next time the same move costs you.

endings.title: The Wish Granted
endings.speaker: vela
lines: You cleared my line, and you did it without flinching or gambling.
endings.next: Take your time. I find the people who earn these ask for smaller things than the ones who don't.
endings.coach_coda: You did that with a plan, not a hunch. That's the part that repeats.

endings.title: The Panic
endings.speaker: vela
lines: You sold at the lowest point on the board. I'll take what's left.
Watch, though. This is what the days after looked like.
endings.next: The dip was temporary. Your decision inside it was not.
endings.coach_coda: Everyone does this once. The people who keep investing are the ones who did it once and understood why. You just did.

endings.title: The Untouched Hundred
endings.speaker: vela
lines: One hundred dollars, exactly as I left it. Not a cent lost.
endings.next: Keeping every dollar and finding out nothing is the only way to truly lose here. Come back when you want to try.
endings.coach_coda: Nothing bad happened. Nothing happened at all. That's the version of this that costs the most over ten years, and nobody ever feels it.

endings.title: The Cost of Certainty
endings.speaker: vela
lines: Beneath my line. I'll take it back, as we agreed.
You held your nerve while it fell, which is more than most manage. It simply fell further.
endings.next: That happens. It will happen again, and it is not a verdict on you.
endings.coach_coda: The money was never yours. What you know now is, and it doesn't go back in her pocket.

endings.title: The Steady Hand
endings.speaker: vela
lines: Between my lines. By my terms, nothing happened at all.
You did not win my wager.
endings.next: You did something harder. You did not flinch, and you did not chase. I have no prize for that, which tells you something about my prizes.
endings.coach_coda: She's wrong about this one, and she knows it. Sitting still while a number goes red is the whole skill. You have it.
